twap_consistent_with_safemode.meaning: twapEMA() interprets the getEMAs() tuple consistently with RiskEngine.isSafeMode()'s correct unpacking order
twap_consistent_with_safemode.checkpoint: after twapEMA() unpacks the getEMAs() tuple

assumptions: getEMAs() returns a five-element tuple whose index positions are fixed as stated in getemas_return_order.
isSafeMode() unpacks getEMAs() in the correct order, so its interpretation is the reference for consistency.

unresolved.description: The report states the intended TWAP as 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons and the actual as (6*slow + 3*fast + spot)/10, but the plan grammar has no division/rate operator and no report-grounded numeric EMA values; the exact weighted formula relation cannot be encoded, so consistency is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: The selected impact is the internal inconsistency of twapEMA() with isSafeMode(); downstream staleness, solvency, and liquidation-bonus consequences are not formalized in this plan.
The consistency Boolean is a report-level identity constraint; concrete EMA values and runtime binding are deferred.
